anchor:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: a single coherent resting character anchor for a future CV audio-tour animation, transparent PNG.
Input images: Image 1 is the body foundation and pose reference. Image 2 is the adult Marju identity, hairstyle, clothes and illustration-style reference, NOT a portrait to replace.
Primary request: complete the body foundation into one whole naturally proportioned seated character, with a matching head, face, eyes, mouth, brown hair, hands resting naturally over the lap at the sweater cuffs, and cream-socked feet in a cross-legged seated pose. New body pose may differ from Image 2: both arms rest down in her lap as in Image 1, no hand propping her cheek. Make all the anatomy join coherently in ONE illustration rather than separate floating pieces.
Style: match the softly painted realistic cartoon illustration of Image 2. Keep Marju's natural face, grey-blue eyes, brown parted hair, small gentle smile, subtle skin texture and ordinary proportions; no beautification, no oversized anime eyes. Loose front hair strands for later subtle motion. Pale textured sweater, dark trousers, cream socks.
Framing: full seated figure from hair crown to socks, centered, sufficient transparent padding around silhouette, no cropped feet or hair. One front-facing character only, no props.
Constraints: transparent background, no checkerboard baked in, no text, no labels, no watermark. Body, head and neck continuous and plausible. This becomes the new fixed anchor, not an exploded layer diagram.

variants.blink:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: closed-eye blink variant of the attached full seated character anchor for a layered web animation.
Input image 1: exact edit target and fixed composition.
Primary request: change ONLY the two eyes from open to gently fully closed in a natural blink, with relaxed eyelids and small lash lines. Keep eyebrows fixed. Do not close mouth or change expression.
Invariants: retain exact same full image framing, canvas proportions, character scale and position, head angle, face landmarks, hair silhouette, neck, clothes, hands, feet, lighting and colors. Nothing except eyes and the tiny immediately surrounding eyelid skin may change. No zoom, no crop, no shifting head. Full seated character must remain visible exactly as anchor.
Transparent background with preserved alpha; no checkerboard, text, labels, watermark.
variants.hair:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: subtle loose-hair motion variant of the attached full seated character anchor.
Input image 1: exact edit target and fixed composition.
Primary request: change ONLY the TWO thin loose front hair strands hanging beside the neck onto the sweater, slightly curving their LOWER TIPS outward as a tiny breath of air. Movement just a few pixels, extremely gentle. Keep roots and upper sections of those strands anchored. The crown, main hair volume and face do not move.
Invariants: retain identical full image framing, canvas proportions, character scale and position, head angle, eyes open, mouth, face landmarks, neck, sweater, hands, trousers and socks. Only thin loose front hair tips and the narrow patch of skin/sweater directly beneath them may change. No pose change, no zoom, no crop, no windblown mane. Full seated figure visible as anchor.
Transparent background with preserved alpha; no checkerboard, text, labels, watermark.
variants.mouth:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: small open-mouth speaking variant of the attached complete seated character anchor for a future CV audio-tour sprite animation.
Input image 1 is the exact full-frame edit target.
Primary request: change ONLY the mouth to a slightly open, relaxed mid-speech shape. A very small natural opening, with a small dark inner-mouth area and only a hint of upper teeth. No large grin, no exaggerated open jaw. Keep the mouth center and corners in the same position.
Invariants: keep identical full image framing, 1261 by 1247 canvas proportions, character scale and position, head angle, cheeks, chin, nose, eyebrows, eyes open, hair, clothing, body, hands, trousers and feet. Change only lips and their immediate few pixels of surrounding skin. Do not move the head, crop or zoom. Retain natural likeness and painted illustration style, no beautification.
Transparent background with preserved alpha. One full seated figure only, no text, labels, checkerboard or watermark.

note: Full-frame source variants are clipped to masks. Only eyes, hair tips and mouth are animated; body, hands and feet stay static.
